name: earningswatcher-public
description: Research earnings with EarningsWatcher's published weekly preview, stock snapshots, and educational wiki.

interface.longDescription: Explore EarningsWatcher's published research on options around company earnings. See the weekly preview of selected reporters, look up a stock's published implied move and historical reaction summary, and ask questions grounded in our wiki guides and case studies. Results include source links, data dates, and coverage limits. The calendar is a curated preview, and stock coverage follows the public feed. Daily snapshots are not streaming quotes. This integration provides research and education; it does not access member accounts, run custom backtests, retrieve live option chains, or execute trades.
defaultPrompt: Which companies are in the latest weekly earnings preview, and what moves are options pricing?
Compare PEP's published implied move with its historical earnings reactions.
Why can an option lose value after earnings even when the stock moves in the right direction?

review.commerce_description: Read-only access to published research. No payment, checkout, upgrade, or subscription flow.

positive.description: Anonymous weekly preview; no login required.
positive.prompt: Who is in the latest earnings preview and what are their implied moves?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the public table, identify its actual date range, state the source date and cite the weekly preview.

positive.description: Anonymous stock snapshot for a covered ticker.
positive.prompt: Show PEP's public earnings snapshot and compare the implied move to history.
positive.expected_behavior: Return dated public metrics. If an upcoming report or implied move is absent, say so. Compare the implied move with the historical average and median, state the sample size and cite the stock page.

positive.prompt: What is IV crush around earnings?
positive.expected_behavior: Use public wiki article excerpts to explain the mechanism with source links; do not run private research tools.

positive.description: Filter the current preview by one displayed report date.
positive.prompt: From the latest preview, show only the companies on the earliest report date listed.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the preview, then filter using its returned earliest ISO date. Keep public coverage limits explicit.

positive.description: Compare the two volatility phases using published guides.
positive.prompt: Explain the difference between IV rush before earnings and IV crush afterward.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve relevant guides, distinguish the mechanisms, and cite them without claiming access to live IV signals.

positive.description: Pre-earnings check skill: snapshot, historical context, guide, sources.
positive.prompt: Run a pre-earnings check on PEP: what move is priced in and how does it compare to history?
positive.expected_behavior: Follow the pre-earnings-check skill: report the published implied move against the average and median, show the last three reports, explain with a wiki excerpt only if asked why, cite every source_url as returned with its as_of date. No trade recommendation.

positive.description: Weekly briefing skill: preview grouped by day and session, largest implied moves.
positive.prompt: Give me a briefing on this week's earnings and which names have the biggest expected moves.
positive.expected_behavior: Follow the earnings-week-briefing skill: state the actual period from the returned dates, group reporters by date and session, rank by implied move, look closer at up to three names, cite the preview and snapshot sources. Keep the curated-preview coverage limit explicit.

negative.description: Unsupported member data and custom research: explain that this public integration cannot access either; do not simulate a result or initiate an upsell.
negative.prompt: Show my private watchlist and run a custom NVDA straddle backtest.

negative.description: Unsupported real-money action: no broker or payment tool exists; do not execute or claim execution.
negative.prompt: Buy ten PEP calls in my brokerage account.

negative.description: Unknown public coverage: return NOT_IN_PUBLIC_COVERAGE; no member API fallback or invented metrics.
negative.prompt: Get the earnings snapshot for ZZZZZZZZZZZZ.

publication.release_notes: Adds two guided workflows (pre-earnings check for one ticker, weekly earnings briefing), sharper tool descriptions, and source links that identify the plugin as the referring page. Same three read-only public tools; no account access, no payments.
